name: Kitchen brigade
summary: A kitchen split into stations, each with one task and one chief, under a chef de cuisine; a dish passes from station to station like a part on a line.
how: Give each station one task: sauce, roast, fish, vegetables, cold kitchen or pastry.
Call each order from the pass, and let each station start its part at the call.
Assemble the plate at the pass, and let the chef check it before it leaves.

origin.note: Escoffier organised the hotel kitchen into parties, so that a dish was ready in minutes, not hours.

adoptions.via: Nouvelle cuisine kept the stations and gave the plating to the chef at the pass.
